title: Lagged CFTC leveraged-fund net-short level as a BTC carry-crash risk proxy
thesis: When the public CME Bitcoin TFF leveraged-fund net-short percentage-of-open-interest level is unusually high relative to its own prior 52 eligible weekly observations, the following 672 hours should exhibit greater BTC crash incidence and price-path drawdown than normal states.
mechanism: BIS evidence links more negative leveraged-fund net-long positioning to higher crypto carry and separately links high carry to future crypto crashes. The frozen proxy is current leveraged-fund short percent of open interest minus long percent, available seven calendar days after each eligible Tuesday report; the high-risk state is strictly above the nearest-rank 75th percentile of the prior 52 eligible levels.
economic_rationale: If the public proxy independently identifies future crash risk in both Design and Validation, a later separately frozen full-capital BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash veto may reduce drawdown and underwater duration enough to improve fee-adjusted Calmar versus matched buy-and-hold. No strategy economics may be opened unless every predictive gate passes.
